note: The ledger holds the changed rows. Held rows are listed by reason in held_by_reason (city ids; a row can appear under more than one reason); their full evidence is in the audit workspace ledger.
methods: Strict containment in exactly one TBB feature at stored WGS84 point. Test ALL boundary chunks against a conservative 2010m enclosing lon/lat box (110000m/degree, cosine at poleward box edge). If any intersect, clip to box, densify to <=0.0001 degree and project to point-centred WGS84 azimuthal equidistant; hold clearance <=2010m (10m safety margin). Coastline and holes count as borders. No candidate escapes a 2km zone-border disk. Compare rules by IANA Link targets, but write only literal zone.tab entries for the row country. Preserve a stored country-listed name when its rules match the polygon. Otherwise prefer an exact country-listed polygon name, then a unique country-listed zone sharing its Link target; hold absent or ambiguous mappings. Conservatively hold any mismatch with stored state timezone, unresolved original identities and special-territory screens. State scalar mismatch is a review hold, not proof the scalar is right.
